pathway.cycleNote: Schools use half-termly assessment windows to assess, regroup and track progress. Between windows, teachers move children through the pathway using professional judgement — no formal test after every book.
pathway.flowTitle: In the classroom — flow inside a level
pathway.flowNote: Sound Books introduce new GPCs with real photographs. Blending Books build decoding confidence (L1–L5 only; from L6 children blend in context inside the storybooks). Storybooks apply the sounds in culturally diverse decodable narratives with built-in practice and a full interactive version.

levels.title: 8 Levels
levels.intro: Each level lists GPCs, tricky words, the decodable rule, and the full resource plan: storybooks, Sound Books, Blending Books and worksheet types.
levels.soundBooksList: Sound Books (real photos · one per GPC)

rules.1: VC or CVC words from the 10 GPCs. No clusters, digraphs, or doubles.
rules.2: CVC and CVCC words using all single-letter GPCs and ck. Double-letter endings (ff, ll, ss) permitted.
rules.3: CVC, CVCC and CCVC words. Adjacent consonant clusters permitted (stop, frog, crisp).
rules.4: All taught GPCs including vowel digraphs and trigraph igh. Two-syllable decodable words introduced.
rules.5: Previously taught GPCs plus split digraphs and first alternative spellings. Multi-syllable increasingly common.
rules.6: Full Phase 5 repertoire including consonant alternatives and alternative pronunciations of known graphemes.
rules.7: Full Phase 5 repertoire including trigraphs. Complex sentence structures expected.
rules.8: Full Phase 5 GPC repertoire plus Phase 6 morphology. Suffix and root changes are explicit teaching points.

letter-tracing.label: Letter tracing
letter-tracing.description: Single graphemes with directional arrows, terminal dot.

handwriting.label: Handwriting (joining)
handwriting.description: Pre-cursive joins, ascender/descender height, line awareness.

alien-words.label: Alien / nonsense words
alien-words.description: PSC-style pseudoword blending. Retired after L6.

tricky-words.label: Tricky word practise
tricky-words.description: Look, cover, write, check + rainbow tracing.

sentence-grammar.label: Sentence & grammar tasks
sentence-grammar.description: Sentence building, capital letters, punctuation, conjunctions.

storybook-pack.label: Storybook worksheet pack
storybook-pack.description: Five A4 sheets per storybook: sound hunt, trace/write, read and do, alien words, sound sort or story-and-draw.

sound-book-worksheet.label: Sound Book worksheet
sound-book-worksheet.description: Lightweight 1–2 page sheet per Sound Book: sound formation, word build, sound sort.

sound-mat.label: Sound mat
sound-mat.description: Cumulative GPC chart for this level (and all earlier levels) — pinned to the table during reading.

tricky-cards.label: Tricky word cards
tricky-cards.description: Cut-and-stick flashcards for the new tricky words introduced at this level.
